fields.label: Rank
fields.description: Higher rank, more authority. Requests climb from the requester's rank upwards.

fields.label: Max discount %
fields.description: Blank or 0 means not set: every discount by this level needs approval.

fields.label: Max commission %
fields.description: Blank or 0 means not set: every commission by this level needs approval.

fields.label: Approves directly
fields.description: Can decide a request still waiting at a lower level, without waiting for it to be forwarded.

fields.label: No limit
fields.description: Any percentage, and may override any decision with a reason (CEO).
